decision_rule_recorded_before_running: Arm F vs arm S on all 224 rows: if the item-clustered bootstrap 95% CI on delta R@1 excludes zero AND the point estimate exceeds +0.05, the template is justified and ships (subject to task 3). If the CI contains zero it does not ship regardless of the point estimate. Arm P is diagnostic only and does not decide.
decision: SHIPS (subject to task 3): CI excludes zero and delta > +0.05
